payload.batch_groups: ascending source IDs, contiguous groups of 256; last group retains its native size

conditions.B1_native: one source, its native input horizon
conditions.B1_padding_matched: one source, padded with zero counts to its corresponding B256 group horizon; same valid-input mask
conditions.B256: all sources in the same contiguous group, zero padding to group maximum horizon
conditions.B256_reversed: same padded tensors and same B/T shapes, with source order reversed and restored after prediction

environment.device_name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

gpu_properties.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

payload.execution: identical frozen model, GPU, runtime, float32, eval, state reset per forward; AMP and TF32 disabled; deterministic algorithms
payload.interpretation: Historical vs fresh B256 drift is reported separately. Fixed GPU hardware does not by itself exclude all batch-shape numerical effects.
payload.role: Estimate hardware/runtime difference at B1, padding difference at B1, and batched execution difference at fixed padding. Reversed B256 keeps group composition and tensor shape fixed.
payload.scores: Pinned public readout: sum over every padded time bin of softmax(logits); no new masking of output scores.
